product_overview: CVCraft is a modern web-based resume builder that enables users to create professional and ATS-friendly resumes. It offers multiple customizable templates, real-time preview with form validation, secure user authentication, and the ability to export resumes as high-quality PDFs, all optimized for responsive use across devices.
core_goals: Provide an intuitive and user-friendly interface for creating professional resumes.
Support multiple professionally designed and customizable resume templates.
Enable real-time preview and editing of resumes.
Implement a secure user authentication system with profile management.
Provide high-quality PDF export that preserves template styling.
Ensure mobile-first responsive design and accessibility across devices.
key_features: User Authentication and Authorization using Supabase, including sign up, sign in, and profile management.
Interactive Resume Builder with tabbed form input for personal info, summary, experience, education, and skills sections.
Multiple professional CV templates, including Modern Blue, Minimal Classic, Creative Edge, Executive Formal, and others.
Real-time resume preview that updates as users input data.
Auto-save functionality and management of multiple resumes per user.
PDF export with template design preservation using jsPDF and html2canvas.
User Dashboard to manage saved resumes and profile information.
Responsive navigation and protected routing for authenticated access.
Blog system with articles and sidebar navigation for additional user engagement.
user_flow_summary: Users register or sign in via the authentication system, with email verification for new accounts.
Authenticated users access the dashboard to create, update, or delete multiple resumes.
Users enter their resume data through a multi-tab form with real-time validation and preview.
Users select and customize their preferred resume template from the templates gallery.
Completed resumes can be exported as PDFs maintaining the selected template's styling.
Users can manage their profile information and upload avatars in the profile section.
Non-authenticated users can browse marketing pages and blog articles.
Navigation components adapt based on user authentication state to provide relevant access.
validation_criteria: Authentication requires email verification and secure session handling with token refresh.
Resume form inputs are validated client-side (using React Hook Form and Zod) and on backend storage.
Real-time preview correctly reflects user inputs immediately without lag or errors.
PDF exports maintain the styling and formatting of the selected template consistently across different templates.
CRUD operations on resumes function correctly with user data isolation and Row Level Security enforced.
The application is responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices with no UI breakage.
Protected routes prevent unauthorized access to sensitive pages like dashboard and profile management.
Security measures including XSS, CSRF protection, and encrypted communications are in place and verified.
